title: Smoke from out of state affecting western Colorado
snippet: The Slough Canyon Fire in eastern Utah was very active on Saturday and produced significant amounts of smoke. Initial expectations were that the majority of smoke would be carried to the north-northeast and have little effect on Colorado air quality. On Sunday morning, observations show that smoke moved into the Grand Valley and bumped PM2.5 (smoke) concentrations into the low Moderate category in Grand Junction.
